CheckTitle: Ensure SoD Within Fusion Is Monitored
Benchmark: CIS Oracle SaaS Cloud Applications Benchmark v1.0.0
SubSectionName: Application Business User Separation of Duties (SoD)
RequiredAccess: Fusion Applications Security Console / Audit Reports (IT Security Manager)
Fusion Cloud Applications Risk Management (Advanced Controls)
Description: Users holding conflicting combinations of Fusion privileges (for example creating suppliers and creating payments) should be monitored.
Risk: Conflicting privileges allow one person to complete a fraudulent transaction end to end.
AuditProcedure: Identify users with conflicting combinations in the Security Console.

Automated alternative: deploy the matching Transaction/Access Controls in Fusion Cloud Applications Risk Management so changes start an investigation workflow. Examples: 4051-4073, 5800, 5810, 5892, 5980, 6080, 6390, 6410.

Steps: Remove unwanted assignments or monitor the users' transactions.
Review the affected transactions in Tools > Reports and Analytics, or monitor them continuously with Risk Management Transaction Controls.
